department: Department of Statistics, Actuarial and Data Sciences

deadline.value: February 15, 2027 for Graduate Assistantship and priority Fall consideration (rolling thereafter until positions fill; admission-only deadline is six weeks before classes / ~July 1 Fall, Jan 11 Spring).
deadline.quote: The deadline for applying for a Graduate Assistantship is February 15. Application materials received after February 15 are considered on a rolling basis until all positions are filled.

gre_general.value: General GRE examination scores are required for admission and Graduate Assistantship consideration.
gre_general.quote: Applicants must submit general GRE examination scores and three letters of recommendation directly to the Department of Statistics, Actuarial and Data Sciences.

gre_subject.value: GRE Mathematics Subject Test requirement is not stated (only General GRE scores are required).

supervisor.value: Not required before admission (an Academic Advisor is assigned upon admission to assist with coursework and milestones).

funding.value: Most Ph.D. students receive a Graduate Teaching or Statistical Consulting Assistantship providing a stipend and tuition waiver (up to 24 academic-year credit hours and 4 summer hours), renewable up to 6 years; admitted students are automatically considered.
funding.quote: Most Ph.D. students receive a tuition waiver and stipend through these assistantships, with funding available for up to six years.

also.quote: Once you are admitted to a STAD graduate program, you will automatically be considered for a Graduate Assistant position. No separate application is required.

entry_route.value: Open to bachelor's holders with 20 semester hours in math/statistics (min 2.7 overall / 3.0 in last 60 hrs and 3.0 in math/stats; 75 graduate credits) as well as master's holders (up to 30 credits counted toward Ph.D.).
entry_route.quote: Applicants with a Bachelor's degree must have successfully completed 20 semester hours of mathematics and statistics including Introduction to Probability and Statistics (equivalent to STA 382), Linear Algebra (equivalent to MTH 223), Multivariate Calculus (equivalent to MTH 233), and Advanced Calculus (equivalent to MTH 532). | Successful completion of the Ph.D., including coursework, internship, and dissertation, requires a minimum of 75 semester hours of graduate work beyond the bachelor's degree.

notes: 75-credit-hour Ph.D. in Statistics and Analytics covering statistical theory, data analytics, computing, and a required 3-credit teaching or industrial internship.
name: Ph.D. in Statistics and Analytics
